title: Misgendering as Breakdown in Human-Machine Communication: How AI Companion Chatbot Users Experience and Repair Misgendering

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of 326 Reddit posts to examine how AI companion chatbots misgender users through identity errors (e.g., incorrect pronouns) and embodiment errors (e.g., incorrect assumptions about gendered anatomy), reinforcing cisnormativity and gender stereotypes.

Qualitative analysis of Reddit posts to identify how AI chatbots reinforce heteronormativity by incorrectly assuming male-female dynamics and misgendering users during same-gender romantic or erotic roleplay.
